detail.longDescription: Another save for the # Synology # ActiveBackupForBusiness . After a corrupted windows OS partition due to boot loop caused by a faulty PSU, the machine was recovered in 30 min (250GB partition) following a PSU replacement. It's always easy when you have an up to date and working backup. 😎 # selfhosting # selfhosted # homelab # disasterrecovery # backup # abb # activeprotect
